description: Fundamental lower-body compound movement training quadriceps, glutes, and adductors.

keyframes.cue: Set feet shoulder-width, bar firmly rested across traps, brace core
Hips back, knees forward, maintain proud chest and neutral spine
Thighs at or below parallel, knees tracking over toes, weight midfoot
Drive floor away through midfoot, chest and hips rising together
Stand tall into full lockout, reset breath and brace for next rep

description: Compound upper-body press targeting pectoralis major, anterior deltoids, and triceps.

keyframes.cue: Eyes under bar, scapulae retracted and depressed, feet planted firmly
Lower bar under control towards sternum, elbows tucked ~45 degrees
Brief light touch at lower chest, maintain full arch and shoulder retraction
Drive feet into floor, press bar up and slightly back toward rack
Lock out elbows over shoulders, maintain shoulder retraction

description: Full posterior chain pull building glutes, hamstrings, back, and grip.

keyframes.cue: Shins touching bar, hips hinged back, lats engaged, slack pulled from bar
Push floor away with legs, bar staying close to shins and thighs
Stand erect, squeeze glutes, shoulders back without hyperextending lower back
Hinge at hips, push glutes back, slide bar down thighs and shins
Bar returns to floor, reset intra-abdominal pressure

description: Hip hinge focused on eccentric loading of hamstrings and glutes.

keyframes.cue: Stand tall, soft bend in knees, shoulders retracted over midfoot
Push hips backwards like closing a car door, bar stays glued to legs
Deep stretch in hamstrings at mid-shin level, spine remains straight
Drive hips forward through floor pressure, squeeze glutes at top
Return to upright lockout without arching lumbar spine

description: Vertical pulling exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi and biceps for V-taper width.

keyframes.cue: Arms fully extended overhead, feel stretch in lats, chest lifted slightly
Drive elbows down and back, pull bar toward upper clavicle
Full lat contraction, squeeze shoulder blades down, do not lean back excessively
Control the ascent, resist the weight stack on the way up
Full lat stretch at the top without shrugging shoulders up to ears

description: Bent-over compound row for upper back, lat, and posterior deltoid thickness.

keyframes.cue: Torso hinged ~45 degrees, arms hanging vertical with bar over midfoot
Pull elbows toward ceiling, driving bar into lower abdomen
Peak contraction: retract scapulae without jerking the torso upwards
Lower bar under control, feeling stretch across upper back
Reset back tension, keep core braced and spine neutral

description: Horizontal pull emphasizing middle trapezius, rhomboids, and latissimus dorsi.

keyframes.cue: Sit upright, knees slightly bent, arms extended feeling back stretch
Pull handle to navel, drive elbows back, squeeze shoulder blades together
Full back contraction, chest proud, avoid leaning back past perpendicular
Control the return forward without rounding the lumbar spine

description: Standing vertical press targeting anterior and lateral deltoids, triceps, and core.

keyframes.cue: Bar resting on anterior deltoids, glutes squeezed, core braced tight
Tuck chin slightly to clear bar path, drive bar vertically in straight line
Lock out overhead, head pushes through window, bar directly over midfoot
Lower bar under control, head pulls back as bar passes nose
Return to front rack position on shoulders, reset breath

description: Isolation shoulder abduction for lateral deltoid width creating the V-taper silhouette.

keyframes.cue: Dumbbells resting at sides, slight forward lean, palms facing inward
Initiate raise through elbows in scapular plane
Raise arms to parallel (~90°), lead with elbows, avoid shrugging
Lower slowly under control, maintain constant lateral delt tension
Brief pause at bottom, keep tension without resting on thighs

description: Horizontal shoulder abduction targeting the posterior deltoid and rhomboids.

keyframes.cue: Hinged forward at hips, dumbbells hanging beneath chest with soft elbows
Fly dumbbells wide in transverse plane, squeeze rear delts without shrugging
Lower dumbbells slowly, resisting gravity through eccentric phase

description: Elbow flexion isolation exercise building the biceps brachii and brachialis.

keyframes.cue: Stand tall, elbows pinned to sides, arms fully extended
Drive forearms upward, keeping elbows locked against ribs
Full peak contraction: squeeze biceps hard, no torso momentum
Control eccentric lowering, fighting gravity with tension
Complete extension at bottom before initiating next rep

description: Cable elbow extension isolating the triceps brachii lateral and medial heads.

keyframes.cue: Elbows tucked close to ribcage at ~90 degrees, slight forward torso lean
Extend arms down into full lockout, flexing triceps hard at bottom
Controlled return to 90 degrees without letting elbows drift forward

description: Heavy closed-chain lower body press on 45-degree machine platform.

keyframes.cue: Seated back flush against pad, feet shoulder-width on sled, knees extended
Lower sled until knees reach 90 degrees, keep lower back firmly on backrest
Press sled away through heels and midfoot, do not harshly lock knees at top

description: Open-chain quadriceps isolation targeting the rectus femoris and vasti.

keyframes.cue: Back against backrest, knee joint aligned with machine pivot axis
Extend knees to horizontal, hold peak contraction on quads for 1 second
Lower pad under control, stopping just before weight stack touches

description: Knee flexion isolation directly targeting the hamstring muscle group.

keyframes.cue: Lying prone, pad rested above Achilles tendons, hips pressed down
Curl heels toward glutes, squeeze hamstrings without lifting hips off bench
Resist the weight stack on the descent to full knee extension

description: Ankle plantarflexion isolating the gastrocnemius and soleus.

keyframes.cue: Balls of feet on step edge, heels hanging below platform feeling stretch
Rise high on big toes, flex calves hard at peak contraction
Lower heels under control beneath step level for a complete stretch

description: Gluteus maximus builder providing maximum tension at full hip extension.

keyframes.cue: Upper back on bench edge, hips down near floor, bar padded over hip crease
Drive through heels into full hip extension, ribs down, chin tucked
Controlled return to bottom without losing bench positioning

description: Bodyweight horizontal press training chest, shoulders, triceps, and anterior core.

keyframes.cue: High plank position, hands under shoulders, rigid core line
Tuck elbows ~45 degrees, pull shoulder blades together smoothly
Hover chest 1 inch above floor, maintain rigid straight line
Drive floor away, chest and hips rising in unison
Push floor away back to full lockout, protracting scapulae at top

description: Bodyweight vertical pull for supreme upper-body strength and lat development.

keyframes.cue: Dead hang from bar, overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders
Engage lats, depress scapulae, initiate pull with elbows
Chin clears the bar cleanly, drive chest toward bar, elbows down
Lower smoothly under complete control, resisting swing
Return to full dead hang stretch before next repetition

description: Isometric anti-extension core exercise for abdominal wall and spinal stability.

keyframes.cue: Forearms on floor under shoulders, toes planted, pull belly button to spine
Breathe rhythmically, maintain straight line from shoulders to ankles
Do not allow hips to sag or hike upwards, complete timed interval

description: Upper chest focus with dumbbells.

keyframes.cue: Retract scapulae and press feet firmly into floor
Lower dumbbells with controlled tempo, elbows at 45 degrees
Feel full stretch across clavicular head of pectoralis
Drive upward along natural converging arc
Lock out dumbbells directly over upper chest

description: Seated shoulder press for deltoid development.

keyframes.cue: Brace core, chest up
Lower weight slowly
Deep stretch at bottom
Press up and slightly in
Lockout at the top

description: Biceps curl with neutral grip.

keyframes.cue: Neutral grip, elbows at sides
Lower weight slowly
Full extension at bottom
Curl weight up
Squeeze at top

description: Hip hinge movement for hamstrings and glutes.

keyframes.cue: Stand tall, dumbbells in front
Hinge at hips, keep back straight
Feel stretch in hamstrings
Drive hips forward
Squeeze glutes at top

description: Cable exercise for rear delts and upper back.

keyframes.cue: Cable pulley at eye level
Control weight back
Full extension
Pull to face, elbows high
Squeeze rear delts

description: Ankle plantarflexion.

keyframes.cue: Stand on block or edge
Lower heels slowly
Deep stretch at bottom
Raise heels high
Squeeze calves at top
